notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
When an opponent controls an untapped creature, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Elvish Mariner triggers, causing you to tap an untapped creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw a card.
Elvish Mariner triggers, causing you to tap nothing.
Repeat as desired.
